style: victorian / belle-epoque harbour terminal; cream stone, verdigris copper roofs, brass and dark glass details; reference image supplied by user (grand central terminal with clock tower, 3-arch portico, arcaded wings, end pavilions, stone quay and waterfront steps)
required_parts: SN_GHT_Quay_Base: rusticated stone quay platform 72.5 x 134 m with coping
SN_GHT_Quay_Stairs: 6-step grand waterfront stair, 24 m wide, flanked by cheek walls
SN_GHT_Quay_Balustrade: stone balustrade around plaza and stair, posts and urns
SN_GHT_Plaza_Furniture: cast-iron lamps, flagpoles, bollards, mooring rings, benches, corner urns
SN_GHT_Central_Block: 42 m wide central block, rusticated plinth, string courses, quoins, rear windows
SN_GHT_Central_Entrance: 8 m deep glazed entrance hall, 15 m wide great arch, brass tracery, rose window, timber doors
SN_GHT_Portico: 4 giant stone columns (17.5 m), entablature, dentils, roof terrace parapet, brass HARBOUR TERMINAL sign
SN_GHT_Wings: two 31 m arcaded wings, upper storey windows with pediments and pilasters, copper roofs
SN_GHT_Wing_Arcades: 6 blind/real arches per wing on piers, glass and timber shopfronts behind
SN_GHT_Wing_Windows: arcade lanterns and secondary joinery
SN_GHT_Pavilions: two 14 m end pavilions, arched windows, oculus, pediment, corner urns, cupola
SN_GHT_Roofs: hipped verdigris copper roofs with ribs, ridge cresting, dormers, chimneys, pavilion cupolas
SN_GHT_Tower: square clock tower, louvered arches, cornice, stone drum, copper dome, lantern and flag
SN_GHT_Tower_Clock: four 4.5 m clock faces with brass markers and iron hands
SN_GHT_Sign: brass text 'HARBOUR TERMINAL' on portico frieze
naming: objects SN_GHT_*; collection SN_GHT_Grand_Harbour_Terminal_Prototype; GLB SN_Grand_Harbour_Terminal.glb
hierarchy: root empty SN_GHT_Root; all meshes parented to root; sign parented to root
scene_rules: do not delete or modify existing scene objects, cameras or lights
only rebuild objects whose name starts with SN_GHT_
do not save .blend or export .glb during build; Lead archives after acceptance
acceptance: geometry_report ok: 15 meshes, tri <= 90k, all boundary/non-manifold/degenerate/loose = 0
all materials are shared SN_Tex_* textures; each mesh has complete UVMap
all four clock faces read from +X/-X/+Y/-Y; tower finial is the highest architectural point
central great arch is a real open recess leading to a glazed hall; wings have real arched arcades
visual: 3/4 and front look like a grand harbour terminal, not a warehouse; copper roofs read green
existing scene objects unchanged (object counts / names / transforms)
